blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, Philippines — Public Works Secretary Giovanni Lopez has warned the contractor of the Gandara Bridge Parallel Project in Gandara, Samar, against further delays, ordering it to strictly meet its April 2027 completion deadline following the collapse of two bridge girders during construction. Lopez issued the directive during his inspection of the project along the Gandara diversion road on Friday, Nov. 20, three days after the two concrete girders fell while workers were installing them.
